kind: Historical decision replay; investigator has read B1 report; no prospective blinding claim.

A.rule: If max J <= 0.1 and last proposal improved, add exactly one response iteration to failed target; otherwise test radius 20 mm cold.
A.action: Replay sealed 126/5 cold run for up_z only, verify 101-prefix identity, retain already passing targets.

B.visible: A plus saved trajectories, saturation, response condition and optimizer status; no new integration.
B.rule: If upper tension headroom and a budget exit coexist with small residual, same extra iteration; ill-conditioning prevents sufficiency claims.

C.diagnostic: Actual B1 up_z best control: 24 +0.02 N control probes; strongest useful coefficient at +0.01 and held-out +0.015 N. Coupled radius ±10/±5 micrometers and held-out +7.5 micrometers. Original constraints at every holding sample.
C.rule: Prefer unchanged-structure continuation unless held-out local radius evidence removes the full residual inside ±10 micrometers while preserving every position constraint. No extrapolation to 2 mm or optimal capability.
C.applicability: No initial affine GVS-T1/T2 or dense single-step transition Jacobian: whole-trajectory sampled constraints are the question. No transplantation of A4 engineering sensitivities.

paired_validation: Only after A/B/C actions saved: read sealed neutral126 up_z; exact prefix audit; charge historical acquisition and separable suffix, never new wall time.

benchmark.priority: B3 six-tendon reach/hold 0.35 s; preserve existing world target [0.29,-0.035,0.19] and thresholds.
benchmark.reason: Mature independent evaluation and native control; dynamic braking tradeoff without changing goals to favor a structure.
benchmark.other_candidates: B1 v2 multi-target costs more per fair control opportunity; load hold blocked by Native external-force support, defer both.

settings.initialization: constant 0.2 N for every candidate; no B1 success controls

benchmark.stopping: Execute four declared candidates once; stop before cap. No target or score changes. Independent replay each best. No global or statistical structural superiority claim.
benchmark.criteria: Prefer benchmark only if reoptimized structural differences remain and neutral is not trivially solved. Pass witness alone does not establish discrimination.
